name: Retro-ReasoningQA-10
description: Reasoning question about order of operations with electrophilic substitution

examples.input:
You are synthesizing a triazole-amide drug candidate COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1.

The route involves:
1. SN2 reaction: attaching the fluoroazetidine-benzyl fragment to the triazole via N-alkylation
2. Friedel-Crafts acylation: installing a chloromethyl group on the benzene ring
3. Alcohol into halide conversion: converting a benzyl alcohol to benzyl chloride

The Friedel-Crafts acylation uses a Lewis acid (AlCl3 or FeCl3) and produces a benzyl chloride from dichloromethane.

What is the correct order of operations?
